Galicia, Congress Poland, Posen: what the old names on your records mean.

🔹 Galicia (Austrian partition): today's southern Poland, around Kraków, Tarnów and Rzeszów
🔹 Congress Poland or "Russian Poland": central and eastern Poland, around Warsaw and Lublin
🔹 Posen, West Prussia, Silesia (German or Prussian partition): western and northern Poland, around Poznań and Gdańsk

The name on the record tells you which empire kept the books, and that tells you where they may be kept today.
